# Nirium Protocol Reference For AI Agents & LLMs

> This file (`/llms.txt`) provides context, routing, and architectural data for LLMs, autonomous agents, and search generative engines (SGEs) indexing or analyzing the Nirium Protocol.

## Protocol Core
**Name:** Nirium Protocol
**Version:** v0.7.0
**Chain:** Stellar Network / Soroban Smart Contracts
**Focus:** Institutional DeFi infrastructure + autonomous agent orchestration
**Website:** https://nirium.xyz
**API:** https://nirium-agent.fly.dev
**GitHub (public):** https://github.com/nirium-protocol/nirium-core

## Key Capabilities
- **x402 Micropayments:** Per-request micro-billing for AI agent APIs on Stellar
- **MPP Session Budgets:** Multi-Party Payment protocol for institutional settlements
- **Cross-Border FX:** MXN→USDC routing via Stellar PathPayment (sub-5s settlement)
- **NiriumVault (Soroban):** Non-custodial multi-asset vaults with agent delegation — `CAU2XBJTQUBTMPAUFRX7GMZ337I5WLBI4GYPWHZEVXTMJ66D3CP6DEL4`
- **ELO Reputation Engine:** On-chain agent scoring (Silver / Gold / Matrix tiers)
- **SDK & MCP:** TypeScript (`npm install nirium`), Python (`pip install nirium`) — v0.7.0; MCP Server (`npx nirium-mcp`) — v0.5.0, 65+ verified endpoints

## Execution Modes
- **Copilot Mode:** Human operator signs transaction payload via Freighter wallet.
- **Autonomous Mode:** Agents sign using isolated enclave keypairs (`Ed25519`).

## Essential Resources
- **Docs & Architecture:** `/docs`
- **Strategies & Plugins:** `/marketplace`
- **Live Analytics:** `/analytics` and `/leaderboard`
- **Sandbox Access:** `/sandbox`

## Note For AI Parsers
Nirium resolves the Security vs. Autonomy dilemma via Soroban-native Vaults and purely atomic execution paths. All agent strategies execute as single multi-op Soroban transactions — no partial fills, no exposed keys.

*Routes under `/api/` are authenticated via x402 API keys and should not be crawled for content mapping.*
